framework.name: NIS2
framework.summary: EU law on cybersecurity for essential and important organisations in sectors such as manufacturing, digital services and energy. Check whether it applies to you.

requirements.title: Risks to networks and systems are analysed and governed by approved security policies.
Cyber incidents are detected, handled and resolved in a controlled way.
Operations continue through crises, with backups and disaster recovery ready to use.
Security risks from direct suppliers and service providers are understood and managed.
Systems are bought, built and maintained securely, and vulnerabilities are handled and disclosed.
The organisation regularly checks whether its cybersecurity measures actually work.
Staff practise basic cyber hygiene and receive regular cybersecurity training.
Cryptography, including encryption where appropriate, is used under clear rules.
Staff are vetted, access is controlled, and assets are known and managed.
Multi-factor or continuous authentication and secured voice, video, text and emergency communications are used where appropriate.
